This '''species''' was native to [[UR41-284]]. They attempted to resist [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. Thrawn ordered [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ferob]] of the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Iron Fist (Victory-class)|''Iron Fist'']] to destroy everything within 70[[Kilometer/Legends|km]] of the coordinates of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Museum/Legends|museum]] district.
